I'm going through a Chinese delivery note from Dongguan Precision Housings, number SN-261008-819 dated 2026-10-08, tied to PO 4500318716. It's addressed to Soony Distribution Center in Hamburg, and I'm now reading the line item for CMP-GAM-010, a die-cast statue called "The Getaway."

I'm checking the quantity on this line, which reads 14.600 PCS. Read with the Chinese decimal convention that's 14.6, but a fractional piece count makes no sense for statues, so I'm weighing that against the 22 kg weight and two packages.

I'm weighing whether the quantity should be recorded as 14.6 or 14,600, since 14.600 PCS conflicts with the 22 kg weight and the two packages. I'll go with the document's decimal convention and flag the ambiguity, and I'm also noting that the stamp carries no date, only a handwritten receiver signature.

Next I'm filling in the packages and weight, and I'm deciding how to handle the handwritten signature, which isn't a correction but still needs recording. I'm also noting the "handle with care" remark and the carrier, and checking whether anything else in the note changes the picture.

I'm settling on how to flag the stamp's overlap: the PCS unit and the "2" count are still readable, so I'll record them as clear and note the truncated item description.

I'm now settling on how to describe the signature on the receiving line, which is handwritten and undated, so I can't tell from it whether the goods were actually received.

verdict.summary_en: Chinese/English delivery note SN-261008-819 dated 2026-10-08 from Dongguan Precision Housings Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg, against PO 4500318716. It carries a red supplier shipping seal and a handwritten signature "Meyer K." on the receiver signature line. There are no receiving date, no receiving stamp and no handwritten corrections.

The item description is cut off ("... die-cast, 18"), so the full specification is not visible.
The receiver signature "Meyer K." has no date and no receiving stamp, so the receipt date and the quantity actually received are not confirmed on this document.
The red seal is the supplier's shipping seal (出货专用章). It carries no date or number and is not a receiving or inspection approval.
observations: Red circular seal reads "DONGGUAN PRECISION HOUSINGS CO LTD" and "出货专用章" (shipping-use seal). It overlaps the unit (PCS) and packages cells in the table, but both are still readable.
Handwritten signature "Meyer K." in blue ink sits on the receiver signature line. It is legible, with no date.
The barcode at top right is not decoded.
The item description is truncated in the table cell.
The lower half of the page is blank.
The packages value (2) appears both in the table and in the footer line.
